visual_checks.name: diff10_structure
visual_checks.evidence: All three diff10 images are dominated by fine, organic speckle consistent with sub-1/255 Mahalanobis cull at Gaussian tails. Top view shows somewhat elevated silhouette-edge noise but it follows the irregular object boundary (ear, arm), not any regular grid, band, or gradient pattern.

reasoning: All 8 visual checks pass. No tile seams, uniform fill blocks, missing-splat holes, color clipping, ringing, NaN/Inf signatures, or geometry shift detected across hero/side/top renders and their diff10 images. The top-view diff10 shows slightly elevated speckle at organic silhouette edges (ear, body boundary) consistent with the Mahalanobis cull trimming sub-1/255 Gaussian tail contributions — this is unstructured noise following the object contour, not a grid or band artifact, and is within acceptable bounds. Numerically: all three views exceed the 35 dB binning-class floor (hero 39.92, side 43.71, top 39.15); per-view PSNR spread is 4.56 dB (well under 20 dB limit); per-view kernel-ms ratio is 1.27x (well under 2x); kernel_ms_median 49.45 ms is -20.1% vs prev_best 61.87 ms; p99/median ratio is 1.24x (well under 3x). All numeric checks pass. Verdict: KEEP.
